svg.title: Status at v0.2.0 (2026-10-13)
svg.desc: #: 1, Result: 41 MCP tools and the same commands on the CLI, sharing live tabs (mcp_conformance 32, test_daemon 102); #: 2, Result: Invisibility guard after every session command in the test suite; zero violations. Daemon runs with the prohibited activation policy; focus regression test fails before 16c35ab; #: 3, Result: All speed targets met at p50 and p95 (docs/evaluation/latency/RESULTS.md): snapshot 0.9 ms socket / 14 ms CLI, click 1.5 / 15 ms, navigate 13 / 27 ms, cold start 408 ms, one-shot read 385 ms; #: 4, Result: Lifecycle tests: auto-spawn, idle exit, stale socket, racing spawns, concurrent clients, SIGTERM, one-shots through a live daemon; #: 5, Result: Agent eval 14/14 in each of five arms (Claude Opus and Sonnet in Claude Code, GPT-6 Sol in Codex), zero critical failures (docs/evaluation/regression/RESULTS.md); #: 6, Result: FIRST (110 tests; live Instagram and LinkedIn reads) and UBC (Canvas pulls, downloads, Kaltura, ubccheck) verified on the installed build; #: 7, Result: README, docs, llms.txt, skill, CI, Homebrew head formula, release zip target
